explanation: Choose every possible left-subtree node count and combine every left and right shape. Memoize these immutable shape sets. Serialize each root breadth-first, emitting 1 for nodes and 0 for all null child positions; the null root therefore becomes [0].
spaceComplexity: O(n·Cₙ), including output; auxiliary memo stores O(Cₙ) shapes
attribution: Original C# implementation and explanation authored for EPI Practice from the displayed problem contract.
correctness: Every n-node binary tree has a unique left-subtree size and an ordered pair of left/right shapes. Combining all sizes and recursive shape pairs enumerates every shape once. Breadth-first serialization writes one marker for every real node and every null child, preserving that shape.
walkthrough: For two nodes, the child is either right or left. Their full breadth-first marker encodings are [1,0,1,0,0] and [1,1,0,0,0].
edgeCases: Left-only and right-only shapes are distinct.
Trailing null-child markers must be retained in this encoding.
